behaviors.description: Report and decline installation of a missing authenticator.
behaviors.preconditions: Independently prepared protected runtime and available candidate app on the autoinstall branch; neither is installed.
behaviors.expected: install-authenticator supplies exact remote and candidate ref on the transaction thread; returning without installation causes transaction failure, no protected download and no deployments.

mappings.rationale: The signal payload and refusal outcome are asserted. Successful installation and resumed authentication are not established, so the full behavior obligation remains unmapped.

surface_assertions.rationale: Exact remote/ref and callback thread are checked; leaving the candidate uninstalled fails the transaction before protected downloads or deployments.

notes: The candidate is an installable placeholder app, not an authentication service. Only refusal is tested.
